title: RunScope and synthetic API monitoring in production

videos.script: The box office is up. Every graph from the last lesson is green. {{green}} And nobody can buy a ticket, because the address customers type points somewhere else since midnight. {{dns}} The server never sees those people, so it has nothing to count. A quiet night, as far as it knows. {{quiet}} This lesson watches from outside. A small program pretends to be a customer, once a minute. {{probe}} It lists the shows, opens one, books a seat, and checks every answer: the status, the body, the time. {{steps}} You will make it fail twice. Once by stopping the server, and once with a box office that still works, only too slowly. {{fail}} Then the awkward part. Every seat the probe books is a real seat, in a real database. {{seats}} So it marks what it writes, cleans up after itself, and is honest about what it cannot see. {{limits}}
